title: retry(): options object and shouldRetry predicate
description:
`retry` now takes an options object (`attempts`, `delayMs`, `shouldRetry`) instead of positional arguments, so callers can stop retrying on errors that will never succeed.

- payments: card declines are no longer retried (we were sending 4 declines per failed checkout)
- inventory: stock reservation logs moved to debug level, they were 30% of our log volume
- tests updated for the new signature
